note: Statewide NYS Tax Parcels Public layer has zero Delaware County records (COUNTY_NAME and SWIS queries return 0); Delaware is not among the counties authorized for it. The only county-specific ArcGIS parcel service (wharcgisdeveloper, ArcGIS Online) returns Token Required. The county COMIT viewer (spatial.vhb.com/comit) is an app with no discoverable public parcel service; Beacon (Schneider) is a search app; other digital parcels are sold commercially or by county request form.
